notes.title: Important update on The Vigilante Diaries’ launch date
notes.notes:
Hello, vigilantes!

First of all, we would like to thank you for your continued support. We're very happy to see that so many of you are excited to play this adventure. It means a lot to us.

Now, onto the big news: we have made the hard decision to [b]delay the launch[/b] of The Vigilante Diaries, but for a [b]very good reason[/b].

Currently, we have a [b]big unannounced project[/b] on our hands, so we had to make adjustments in the team and shift most of our focus and resources to that. That’s why The Vigilante Diaries had to take the backseat for a while.

Once again, we want to stress that this is just [b]temporary[/b], and that The Vigilante Diaries is still moving forward and we’re still making progress on the game. This story is something we’re very passionate about and we want you guys to experience it too.

Thank you for your understanding and support, and we hope we will be able to share more news and advancements with you very soon!

And we hope you will be as excited about the new project as we are!

Take this chance to [b]meet the vigilante[/b] and learn more about his motives to start fighting crime through his own means by reading his journal, where you’ll find an account of his struggles and make choices that will affect his story.

notes.title: THE DEV DIARIES #2 - GAMEPLAY
notes.notes:
In this new installment of [b]The Dev Diaries[/b], we wanted to go a bit more in depth about the [b]gameplay[/b] and [b]mechanics[/b] of [b]The Vigilante Diaries[/b]. The game is a [b]narrative RPG adventure[/b] where every decision the player makes will have consequences. As we already stated in the first diary, it draws inspiration from great referents of the genre such as [i]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/i] or [i]Suzerain[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/aadf62d88a8374e0f248f05a2c8ee9c0be1d650b.png[/img]

In [b]The Vigilante Diaries[/b], you’ll put yourself in the shoes of a man and recap his life, going from his childhood to the moment he became a masked vigilante, and what happened after. You’ll be able to choose your vigilante’s [b]nickname[/b], customize his [b]appearance[/b] and pick his [b]tools[/b]: will you fight crime from the shadows or will you face it head-on with your own fists?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/37e307cf6c7ad956f0a4c9f61a42535839ed8088.png[/img]

The story of the vigilante will be divided into chapters, and will show you key moments of his life, like the time he served in Vietnam. You’ll go through these memories by reading his journal, where you’ll see them unfold through [b]hand-drawn illustrations[/b] that will immerse you in the story.


Interacting with the journal and turning the pages, you will discover the story of crime, vengeance and justice that surrounds the vigilante. And as you make decisions, they will all have [b]consequences[/b], affecting your [b]relationship[/b] with other characters, the way you face danger, your [b]abilities and stats[/b], and even your standing in the [b]political spectrum[/b] of the game. This means that, for example, if you want to beat an enemy, you’ll have to have the strength required if you want to succeed. Or if you want to successfully infiltrate a private party of the mafia, you’ll have to have enough stealth points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/c838b610b7dde2a0d9d82ed028c3155fb7a1ec68.png[/img]

Aside from the journal, the game also features events that take place in [b]the vigilante’s hideout[/b], a place with comic book aesthetics that you will be able to explore freely from a [b]first-person perspective[/b]. And while you’re here, the police radio can go off at any moment announcing that there’s been some sort of incident, so you will have to be ready to respond to its call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/5ac1282de918af051623343a4dfdfd2f2624feb8.png[/img]

Thanks to all these different mechanics and choices, the story can [b]branch[/b] out in many different ways. And since each of you is going to make different decisions that will alter the course of the whole story, [b]every single playthrough will be different[/b]. The lives of the vigilante’s loved ones, revenges that may be completed or not, enemies that might be redeemed or not… There are many things that can change depending on your decisions. And it will be all in your hands, vigilante.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841600/The_Vigilante_Diaries

notes.title: THE DEV DIARIES #1 - Inspirations
notes.notes:
When creating The Vigilante Diaries, we have drawn inspiration from many different forms of media to create a compelling experience with the aesthetics we envisioned.

As far as the gameplay is concerned, we drew inspiration from narrative RPGs such as [b]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/b], [b]Suzerain[/b] or [b]The Pale Beyond[/b]. We wanted a story with choices, where the narrative was at the center, and there was a lot of branching and replay value. We were also aiming for a [b]story focused on conflict[/b] and that was politically and ethically charged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/e6ec9c143dfb0e05d27c5626c7003b19140e3935.png[/img]

As for the vigilante himself, depending on your decisions he can turn out very differently, but within a range of possibilities. There was an article about [b]Captain America[/b] that said Republicans would want him to kill Bin Laden, while the democrats would want him to expose the president, and [b]those two sides are the kind of choice we wanted to give[/b] our players.

To create the image of our vigilante, we’ve looked at many different characters and stories, but mainly those with mundane superheroes, meaning those that don’t have powers and don’t use unbelievable gadgets. From things like [b]Kick Ass[/b] by Mark Millar to [b]Kill Or Be Killed[/b] by Brubaker and Phillips, and from classics like [b]The Spirit[/b], [b]The Shadow[/b], to more modern vigilantes like [b]Question[/b] or [b]Rorschach[/b] from Watchmen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/758d24d43d8d67f31ac844c9f937da3d8b35f6f8.png[/img]

We have looked at other heroes like [b]Batman[/b] or [b]Spiderman[/b] too. Because, even though sometimes we forget, they’re also masked vigilantes who beat up people, and technically, that’s against the law. Does that mean that their way of fighting crime and helping those in need is wrong? Well, that’s not for us to judge or decide.

Finally, as for the setting and the general vibe and aesthetic of the game, we’ve also looked at movies and TV shows that represent the different types of vigilantes you can become in the game, such as [b]V for Vendetta[/b] or [b]The Punisher[/b], movies from the 70s and 80s set in the United States of the time, such as [b]Taxi Driver[/b], others like [b]Unbreakable[/b], which addresses the plausibility of a superhero existing in the real world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972642/5be777862cf6379c74fce8639128b40825f21987.png[/img]

As you can see, The Vigilante Diaries is a mix of inspirations, but we’re trying to take a [b]realistic approach[/b] to the situation and looking at the [b]political and moral implications[/b] of it all. What do you think of these inspirations? Are you a fan of any of these works? We encourage you to leave a comment.

If you’re interested in the vigilante and his story, remember to add the game to your Steam wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841600/The_Vigilante_Diaries/

notes.title: The Vigilante Diaries, from the devs of American Arcadia and Call of the Sea!
notes.notes:
After launching both Call of the Sea and American Arcadia, we are excited to announce that we’re working on a new game: [b]The Vigilante Diaries: An Out of the Blue Story[/b].

In [b]The Vigilante Diaries[/b], you’ll put yourself in the shoes of a working-class man that returns to his hometown after two tours of duty in the Vietnam War, where he’ll be faced with a city ravaged by crime, corruption and social inequality. In this situation, the only way out for someone like him will be [b]taking justice into his own hands[/b]!

[previewyoutube=1pdlvP_SMWU;full][/previewyoutube]
Be ready to recap his life as a masked vigilante, and to define not only his appearance, but also his [b]rules[/b], [b]methods[/b] and [b]red lines[/b]. As you go through his Journal, you will be faced with choices in a raw account of the struggles, hardships and pivotal moments that drove him to become a masked vigilante, and the events that took place after. What kind of crimefighter will you become?

This is the first story of an anthology we’re working on called [b]An Out Of The Blue Story[/b], and each of the stories in it will focus on different characters in very different settings, but with one thing in common: the question [i]“how far would you go to survive?”[/i].

We hope you will like it! You can Wishlist it now, down here, and you can also follow Out Of The Blue on [url=https://twitter.com/OutBlueGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/outbluegames/]Instagram[/url] to stay tuned for future updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841600/The_Vigilante_Diaries/
